title: Launch party for London Town by Wings | 1978
content:
A launch party for Wings’ sixth studio album London Town was held on 22 March 1978.

The party was held on a boat which travelled along the River Thames. It was due to leave Embankment Pier at 1pm, but Paul and Linda McCartney were absent at that time. MPL’s press officer Tony Brainsby chose to go ahead without them, but 10 minutes later the boat had to return to the pier to pick up the late arrivals.

The event was primarily a press launch, and had journalists from Melody Maker, the Sun, Daily Mirror, Daily Express, Daily Mail, and Evening Standards. The McCartneys and Denny Laine had their photographs taken at the front of the boat, with Tower Bridge in the background, while eating fish and chips wrapped in newspaper.

Following the event, MM journalist Colin Irwin was invited to Trillion Video Post-Production in Soho, where Michael Lindsay-Hogg was editing music videos for ‘With A Little Luck’ and ‘London Town’. Afterwards, Paul and Denny gave an interview to Your Mother Wouldn’t Like It on Capital Radio.
